summary: Visual budgeting interface with USD Transactions addresses ending at the month (legacy /usd links remain supported), browser-saved text-column widths, complete-selection compound register sorting, Group > Category labels and calendar-month navigation; financial decisions use shared ledger operations.

operations.name: interface
operations.summary: Provide the declared web interface or remote authority adapter.

output.description: The operation result in the enclosing response data field.

operations.side_effects: The interface delegates explicit reads/mutations to public services; it does not define financial rules. Account, Payee, Category and Memo resize controls save only column keys and pixel widths in browser local storage; resizing never writes financial data or history.
operations.permissions: Host-scoped SDK access; this callback is not remotely callable.
operations.scope: Host-supplied budget/environment context and personal/demo workspace where the method accepts it. Credentials remain machine-local.
errors: Invalid or unsupported input is rejected without applying a new decision.
Unavailable feature/storage returns an authored error; stale revisions and reused request IDs with different intent conflict.
operations.retry: Read again as needed; reads never authorize a later write using an old revision.
operations.availability: SDK callback only; consult the owning README for the typed in-process contract.

operations.permissions: Existing verified HTTPS budget/workspace access; writes require an observed revision and unique request ID. Agent/batch attribution uses the public history context.
operations.scope: One addressed budget/environment/workspace. No cross-currency or cross-budget matching.
errors: Missing/deleted/duplicate IDs, pending/categorized entries, archived accounts, differing currencies/scopes, unequal opposite amounts, dates more than seven days apart or an existing pair reject confirmation before mutation.
Stale preview/revision and conflicting request reuse fail. Unsupported backends fail before mutation.
More than 1,000 proposals fails explicitly; narrow dates/accounts. Pagination is explicit, never silent truncation.
operations.retry: Reads may be repeated. Exact successful writes retain original operation/workspace/payload/revision/request ID/history and return the original durable receipt after restart. Never retry an uncertain write with fresh intent.
operations.availability: WHAB 2.74+, optional TransferMatching SDK; SQLite 1.24+ / JSON 1.16+, or an authority with the same capability.
operations.name: transfers.suggestions
operations.summary: Transactions review panel: Read-only possible transfer pairs: equal opposite nonzero amounts, same currency/budget scope, different active accounts, posted/uncategorized/unmatched, within seven days. All alternatives remain proposals; no automatic match or review.

since.description: Inclusive anchor start YYYY-MM-DD; its opposite leg may be up to seven days outside the range.

currency.description: One uppercase ISO currency; omit for separate candidates in all currencies.

accountIds.description: Optional anchor accounts. The opposite leg may be any eligible account in this workspace.

offset.description: Explicit next offset from the previous result; require an unchanged revision across pages.

candidates.description: Possible pairs with transactionIds, both complete public transactions and accountName, daysApart, bankHint, ambiguous and reason. A match is not proof and never changes records.

items.description: A possible pair; alternatives may share transaction IDs and require an explicit user choice.

total.description: Exact count of proposals for this selection.

operations.side_effects: None. This deterministic read performs no bank sync, save, classification, review or reservation.

operations.side_effects: One native transaction, one reversible exact before/after audit entry, durable receipt, revision and synchronous checkpoint. Matching writes reciprocal transferPeerId plus isTransfer=true and reviewed=false. Unmatching removes the links, restores isTransfer from existing inferredTransfer and sets reviewed=false. No bank sync. No standing future rule.
